description: Answer from lessons learned in real Godot 4 projects and on this machine: what went wrong, why in Godot terms, the fix, and how to test it. Find them by `query` (words such as 'helicopter slides off moving ship', or a lesson id), by `error` (a Godot message exactly as printed: the lessons that explain it), by `rule` (the lessons behind a review or model rule), or narrow by `topic` (gdscript, physics, rendering, import, models, world, performance, gameplay, ui, audio, tooling, process). Without any of them it lists the lessons. `gaps: true` instead lists the Godot errors seen on this machine (and by other installs) that no review rule predicted and no lesson explains yet: what to teach Godotwright next. Use it when Godot shows an error you do not understand, and before you build moving platforms, vehicles, ships, large worlds, runtime-loaded models, shaders or headless tests. `detail` brief gives the title and fix; full adds symptom, cause, test, rules and the Godot message. Returns plain text; lessons learned here are marked. It counts which lessons were shown in the local learning file (GODOTWRIGHT_LEARN=0 turns that off). Say whether one helped with godot_feedback (`lesson`).

detail.description: brief: short output with capped lists; full: everything (default for this cheap profile: brief).

error.description: a Godot error or warning message, as printed

gaps.description: list what Godotwright cannot predict yet instead of lessons

rule.description: a rule id from godot_review or godot_model_lint, e.g. api/infer-variant

name: godot_lessons
title: Lessons from real Godot projects
